newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 9.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Monday's Daily Variety:
* "Con Air" soared to new heights this weekend. The movie by Walt Disney Co's Buena Vista brought in an estimated $25.5 million in its debuted weekend.
* Castle Rock Entertainment has reduced its staff to 60 employees, about half of its staff.

* A large percentage of television shows deemed "FCC friendly" for kids does not qualify as educational "by any reasonable benchmark," according to a study to be released Monday by the Annenberg Public Policy Center in Washington.
* Warner Bros. Domestic's "The Drew Carey Show" is to appear on WNYW, the Fox owned and operated station in New York, which is paying up about $175,000 an episode for exclusive N.Y. rights.
* Jack Shea has been elected president of the Directors Guild of America.
* Two key lawmakers have urged Seagram Co Ltd's Universal Studios to scale back expansion plans by as much as 40 percent and eliminate plans for a new theme park.
